name: ccp-tokenized-margin
title: CCP Tokenized-Margin Acceptance Evidence
description: Three-step composed evidence chain for a clearing member posting tokenized collateral as margin to a central counterparty. Step 1 applies the caller's versioned acceptable-collateral haircut table, for example a CCP's published schedule, to the tokenized items and returns the haircut-adjusted collateral total and net exposure. Step 2 builds the conditional-relief collateral receipt: a per-condition PASS/FAIL/UNDECIDABLE verdict against the caller's own versioned condition set, such as the CFTC tokenized-collateral guidance, a CFTC no-action letter or the SEC staff no-action letter to DTC, plus a version-staleness check, the applicable capital charge and the revocation-exposure figure. Step 3 compares two central counterparties' published quantitative disclosures. Every input is caller-asserted: the chain shows the declared conditions were checked against the declared facts, not that the facts are true.
regulatory_refs: CFTC Letter No. 25-40 (no-action position, digital assets as margin collateral, 2025-12-08)
SEC Division of Trading and Markets no-action letter to The Depository Trust Company (2025-12-11)
17 CFR 39.13(g) (DCO initial margin asset eligibility and haircuts)

steps.handoff: collateral_adjusted_total and net_exposure feed the conditional-relief receipt as the haircut-adjusted collateral value under the caller's versioned haircut table.
all_conditions_met and applicable_capital_charge record whether every declared relief condition held for the accepted collateral before the CCP disclosure comparison.
fully_available_field_count and source_citations are the chain output: the published CCP disclosure fields compared alongside the acceptance evidence.
